document: National Identification Number (NIN) and its slip
office: the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC), at its offices and licensed enrolment partners

routes.label: enrolment at a NIMC office or licensed partner
premium enrolment at a licensed lounge, visa centre or by appointment
a lost or damaged NIN slip reissued at a NIMC office
a lost or damaged NIN slip reissued at a premium provider

note: NIMC's Service Charter (August 2025), section 15, Schedule Of Fees For Services Rendered (read 2026-11-03 from its page images; the pages have no text layer): regular enrolment and the first NIN slip cost nothing (NIL); premium enrolment, a franchise for VIP enrolment at a premium provider, costs N20,000; a lost or damaged NIN slip is reissued for N600 at a NIMC office and N3,500 at a premium provider. A date-of-birth correction (N28,574), other changes (N2,000), the general multipurpose card (N7,000 to issue or to replace) and enrolment abroad (in African countries, USD 50 for an adult, 30 for a child) aren't modelled. Nigeria's identity document in practice is the NIN and its slip; the time and the term aren't stated.

sources.title: National Identity Management Commission, NIMC Service Charter (August 2025), section 15.0 Schedule Of Fees For Services Rendered (printed pp. 30-34)
sources.said: 15.1 ENROLMENT SERVICES, PREMIUM ENROLMENT ... 1 Enrollment (Franchise for VIP Enrolment) 20,000.00; 2 NIN Slip Re-issuance (Local) 3,500.00; 3 ER- Migration (Child to Adult) FREE. 15.2 CARD SERVICES ... 1 Card issuance (Local) ₦7,000.00 ... 15.4 NON-PREMIUM SERVICES (REGULAR ENROLMENT) ... 1 Enrolment and issuance of 1st NIN slip NIL; 2 NIN Slip Re-issuance (Re-issuance of Lost or Damaged NIN Slip) 600.00; 3 NIN Slip Self Service 1,000.00. 15.5 REGULAR MODIFICATION SERVICES FOR NIGERIA: 1 Correction of Date of Birth (Day, Month, Year) 28,574.00; 2 Modification of any other field other than DOB per transaction (names, address, etc.) 2,000.00. 16.1 REGULAR ENROLMENT SERVICES FOR AFRICAN COUNTRIES ($): 1 CR-New Enrolment (Adult) 50.00; 2 ER-New Enrolment (Child) 30.00
